acceptanceCriteria: Campaign failure output names each failed check with measured and limit values.
The latency criterion is load-robust by a documented method, with a test showing a loaded-host sample passes and a real regression still fails.
Spec/requirement updated in the same change.
body: checks[latency] uses absolute p95 limits (query 500 ms, lifecycle 250 ms) that ordinary host load crosses; 14/45 campaign tries failed only on latency. Make the latency check robust to host load (e.g. measure against a same-run host baseline or retry the latency sample set once) without hiding real regressions, and print which check failed with measured values vs limits on campaign failure.
title: GH #1218: OpenCode native qualification latency check flakes on host load; report the failing check and margin
